+Collapsed Card contract: title remains the primary text; compact authorized labels may precede it in the user-approved Trello-style presentation. The title wraps/clamps to three lines with full accessible name and full title in detail; affected units next when supported (first two plus “+N units”; common property is explicit scope, never a fake unit). Show assignee names/initials from authorized version-bound previews; explicit Unassigned only for a valid zero-member preview, unavailable data must not imply unassigned. Due date shows day/month/year in board/viewer timezone, with existing textual overdue/complete state. Missing date says No due date. Priority only when backed by PRD-34 data. Count indicators only from bounded authorized aggregate previews; no per-card child fetches. Do not repeat List status on each card. Descriptions, email bodies, vote details and histories stay in detail. Units/priority/counts not present in the API remain tracked gaps, not invented placeholder data.

+Detail hierarchy: Summary and core editing; Description, checklist and attachments; Related records when backed by services; Discussion and Activity labeled separately. Core save and close stay visible; secondary operations have a labeled disclosure. Desktop right panel and full-screen phone presentation share the stable existing Card URL. Keep the board mounted, its filter result, horizontal/vertical scroll and origin focus. Back behaves as close when board history exists. Dirty core edits require explicit discard before closing or navigating, and browser unload protection. No client draft bypasses permission revocation. Failed saves keep input and original retry identity; pending/uncertain commands retain existing recovery controls. Do not unmount recovery-owning components merely to hide them.

+`VITE_STRATAAI_WORK_UX` defaults on. Set it to `0` and rebuild to restore inline secondary action rows and centered Card details with inline Save. Stable routes, permissions, command identity, archive/audit, card data and core draft protection remain unchanged. This build-time flag never reparents pending recovery controls within a session. Test both settings before integration. Remove only after accepted new/rollback journeys and current release evidence. Native details disclosures preserve multi-step command owners and independent dialog recovery instead of nesting those controls in a composite ARIA menu.
